name: Stone Slide
description: Smooth river stones sit in a frame with one gap. Slide them, one at a time, until the numbers run in order. A fresh scramble each day, or as many new ones as you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A frame of numbered river stones with one empty space. A stone beside the space can slide into it.
help.goal: Put the stones in order, 1 first, reading left to right and top to bottom, with the space in the last corner. There is no timer; fewer moves is nicer.
howToPlay: Press a stone that touches the empty space (not diagonally). It slides into the space.
Keep sliding until the numbers run in order and the space is in the bottom right corner.
Every scramble is made by sliding stones from the solved frame, so it can always be solved.
Today's stones is the same scramble for everyone today. New stones deals a fresh one. Size switches between 4 by 4 and a smaller 3 by 3.
Undo takes back your last slide. Restart puts the stones back to how they began.

controls.action: Slide the focused stone into the space
Jump to the start or end of the row
Reach Undo, Restart and the other buttons

tips: Solve the top row first, then the next, and leave the last two rows for the end.
Each stone has its own pattern and shade as well as a number, so you can match them by look.
You can stop at any time. Your stones are saved and wait for you.
